proof_body:
by
  intro E _ _ _ φ g φ' g' a hex hg hφ hne
  obtain ⟨p, q, hpq, h⟩ := hex.exists_multipliers_of_hasStrictFDerivAt_1d hg hφ
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    have hp : p ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hpq rfl
    rw [zero_smul, add_zero] at h
    exact hne ((smul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left hp)
  refine ⟨-(p / q), ?_⟩
  ext x
  have hx := congrArg (fun T : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => T x) h
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at hx ⊢
  field_simp
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (φ g : E → ℝ) (φ' g' : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (a : E), IsLocalExtrOn φ {x | g x = g a} a → HasStrictFDerivAt g g' a → HasStrictFDerivAt φ φ' a → g' ≠ 0 → ∃ l : ℝ, φ' = l • g'
